lead_raw_text:
The MgMn structure (Mg₈Mn₈ per unit cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 143), with 16 atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both elements: each Mg and Mn center has 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg–Mg/Mn neighbor distances of 2.99–3.22 Å and Mn–Mg/Mn distances of 2.91–3.19 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Mg–Mg and Mg–Mn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Mn–Mn pairs share corners and edges.
